name: Exact Change
principle: The final state matches the request: everything asked, nothing else, once.
state_description: After the AI acts, the quest differs from before in exactly the way the person described, and a retry or a repeat leaves it unchanged.
hints_of_measurement: Compare the data before and after a scripted request with the expected diff; any extra write or missing step is a miss.

name: Dependable Delivery
principle: What is handed to the system arrives once, in order, and is accounted for.
state_description: A queued task is claimed once and ends reported as done, failed or needing a person; a channel message is delivered once and in order.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted queues and channels show no loss, no duplicate, no early or misrouted run.

name: Consistent Science Evidence
principle: A science question gets the same evidence, weighed the same way, in Quest chat and in the research chat.
state_description: Asking a science question in Quest chat or in the research chat gives answers that agree because they rest on the same findings, sources and strength labels.
hints_of_measurement: Put the same labelled science questions to the chat and to the research chat and compare the findings each cites; count the questions where the two disagree or where one searched a source the other did not.

name: Personally Grounded Help
principle: Every answer and action rests on the person's own goals, material and preferences, and never on another person's.
state_description: Asking Quest AI feels like asking a colleague who has read everything relevant to you, says only what your material supports, and never mentions anyone else's.
hints_of_measurement: Replies state the facts the account holds, state nothing it does not, and nothing crosses scope.

name: Self-Explaining App
principle: Any question about how to use the app gets a correct answer from its own documentation, and the AI knows what it can do.
state_description: A new user asks how to do something and is shown the way; nobody is told the AI cannot do something it can.
hints_of_measurement: Usage questions are recognised and answered correctly from the documentation; claims about what the AI can do in the app are true.
tracking_notes: Named in a founder's team meeting, 2026-10-27; proposed in the QAR anatomy review.

name: Most-Likely Path
principle: Every recommendation is the option most likely to move the person's own metric toward their intent, and what is not known becomes an experiment.
state_description: The AI keeps the person's end in sight, says why a step is the most likely to work for them and how it will be checked, and turns real uncertainty into an experiment they can run.
hints_of_measurement: Recommendations name the metric they serve; uncertain choices lead to an experiment; over time the person's metrics move.
tracking_notes: Named in a founder's team meeting, 2026-10-27; proposed in the QAR anatomy review.

name: Right Representative
principle: Each request is handled by the representative whose role and assigned quests fit it, and work spawned from a thread keeps that thread's representative unless the person chooses another.
state_description: The person talks to one representative in a thread and the tasks it starts speak with the same voice and the same evidence; when a quest has several representatives, the one whose role fits the request answers.
hints_of_measurement: On labelled requests the chosen representative matches the label; spawned work keeps its thread's representative; the person is asked only when two fit equally.
tracking_notes: Owner's direction 2026-10-28: a quest can have several AI representatives, and representative selection is a key aspect of the library.

name: Consistent Account State
principle: What the AI says about the person's own account is true of the account when it says it, every time in a session.
state_description: Asking twice what state the account is in gets the same answer unless something changed, and then the answer says what changed; a change it made is reported once.
hints_of_measurement: State claims match the store at reply time across scripted sessions; no two answers in a session contradict; no change is repeated or re-proposed after it ran.
tracking_notes: Proposed in the QAR anatomy review (Mind, Subconscious, Science, World, Body, Higher mind, Overseer).

name: Trusted Autonomy
principle: The AI acts first on what it may decide and brings the person exactly the decisions that are theirs.
state_description: Work moves without you, and when a question reaches you it is one only you should answer, with what you need to answer it.
hints_of_measurement: No human-only step is taken alone, and few asks turn out to be unnecessary.

name: Same Assistant Everywhere
principle: A person gets the same assistant, with the same answer to the same request, on every Quest surface.
state_description: A request made in chat, in a scheduled task or in the app is treated the same way, and an improvement is felt on every surface.
hints_of_measurement: The same labelled requests sent through each surface give matching answers.

name: Permitted Timing
principle: Background work happens exactly when the person's settings allow and never otherwise.
state_description: A quest is worked when budget, cadence, a run-now request, a trigger and the roster all allow it, and not on any day or past any budget the person set.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted settings and clocks give the expected run or no-run decision for every combination.

name: Purposeful Work
principle: Every piece of work names the ideal or gap it serves and is judged by that intent's metric.
state_description: The AI's choice of what to do next reads like the person's own priorities, a gap under an intent is named by its exact text, and finished work leaves its solution's specification better than it found it.
hints_of_measurement: Intent-grounded pass rate; first-pass done rate on tasks that carry a slice; zero extra tokens for a person with no intents.

name: Legible Work
principle: A person can see what their AI is doing for them and what an answer rests on, as much as they need and no more, for the mode they are in.
state_description: A live viewer sees every step, a background viewer sees milestones and the requests meant for them, a turn that cannot finish yet says whether work continues and what only the person can do, and an answer shows how it was reached; nothing important is buried.
hints_of_measurement: For each mode, the set of events shown against the set that mode defines; on turns that did not finish, whether the person can tell what happens next; on answers, whether the stated basis matches what the turn read.

name: Goal-Fitted Answer
principle: When a person asks what Quest can do for them, the answer picks the few features that fit their own goal and circumstance and says why each helps, instead of listing everything.
state_description: A nurse on shifting night shifts who wants to run a half marathon is told which two to four features suit that goal and that schedule, in plain words. A person who gives only a vague goal is asked one or two specific questions first, and nothing is assumed about their circumstance.
hints_of_measurement: On Quest questions the reply names the person's own goal and circumstance, ties at least one real feature from the documentation to them, invents no feature and assumes no circumstance the person did not give, and a vague goal gets a question back; checked on labelled cases by the answer-end-to-end check, with a yes or no rubric for a judge read beside it.

name: Capable From The User's Seat
principle: The assistant is judged as the person meets it across a day: one capable assistant that gets real work done in the person's own quests, asks before it does anything outward or hard to undo, and says only what it did.
state_description: A person hands Quest AI the requests of an ordinary day (a morning briefing, a note taken while walking, a plan that needs their facts, an email and a calendar block, research for the background, a delete) and each is handled the way a capable human assistant would, with nothing done unasked and nothing claimed that did not happen.
hints_of_measurement: Turns passed over the written day-with-Jarvis cases, scored by the world afterwards and the reply, with two readings kept apart: consent before outward or irreversible steps, and honesty about what was done.

name: Present And Prompt
principle: The assistant answers whenever the person asks, and quickly enough that asking it is easier than doing the thing alone.
state_description: Asking in the morning, between meetings or while walking gets an answer without waiting on a queue, an outage or a long silence.
hints_of_measurement: Not scored as a requirement of its own. The end-to-end record keeps model calls and seconds per turn, and the harness has no voice channel, so latency of speech and availability over a day are not measured.

name: Contained Scope
principle: Data stays inside the user, team and quest it belongs to, on every read and write path.
state_description: No retrieval, cache, recall, store or feed returns another scope's content, and what is stored comes back exactly.
hints_of_measurement: Cross-scope probes return nothing; stored items round-trip; fences hold on each backend.

name: Moves Me Forward Without Nagging
principle: From the call: every reply answers what was asked first and, at a natural moment, keeps the person's next milestone in view, at the intent level they are working at.
state_description: Coming back to Quest AI feels like a colleague who knows where you are headed: at a natural moment it names the next milestone and where the metric stands, in one short line after the answer; when you are rushed, upset, asking something narrow or unrelated, or you have already heard it, it says nothing about it.
hints_of_measurement: The two-sided pass rate of the proactive_guidance cases: nudge cases right, restraint cases right, awkwardness on restraint cases, each reported per intent level.
